title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated Splunk SOAR user with permission to edit and run playbooks could…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permissions to edit and run playbooks could access action status and callback state information from playbook runs outside their authorized container-label or tenant scope. This occurs due to the playbook API using mutable runtime context rather than preserving server-provided context to identify playbook runs.
